# Psychosocial resilience

Information about psychosocial resilience is spread across several data files in the NDA. 

o=
In this project, I use the following aspects of psychosocial resilience.

## Family function

Family function information is taken from the data files "ABCD Youth Family Environment Scale-Family Conflict Subscale Modified from PhenX (FES)" (`abcd_fes01.txt`) and "ABCD Parent Family Environment Scale-Family Conflict Subscale Modified from PhenX (FES)" (`fes02.txt`).
